facts.fact: The national statistics institute (INS) said results of its household and enterprise ICT survey, run at the end of 2023 with Expertise France and Afristat under the Datafid project, were presented on 23 April 2024.

facts.fact: The INS survey presented on 23 April 2024, carried out at the end of 2023, found that 50% of Ivorians have access to the internet, 65.7% in towns and 29.4% in rural areas.
facts.system: INS household and enterprise ICT survey (Datafid)
